data.content_ref: inline:The abstraction is unsound because it maps a structural requirement (separate engines with genuinely different priors) onto a purely behavioral one (divergent latent trajectories within the same model), which is not an abstraction but a category change. The stated refutation condition does not actually protect against this: a stylistic divergence is just one easy failure mode, but the deeper fault is that a single model's latent trajectories remain drawn from the same training distribution and inductive biases regardless of prompting, so 'divergent latent trajectories' can never substitute for genuinely independent priors. The target conflates surface-level behavioral variance with architectural independence.
